subject_judgments.review_rationale: Babeuf doctrine and Conspiracy of Equals paths retrieve class/property goals, broader constitutional appeal, club response, the detailed coup and betrayal on326 and the qualified trial outcome330. Year V elections leads through the heterogeneous majority and peace dispute329–330; balancing and Fructidor paths reach executive divisions, military preparation and the rejected moderate alternative331. No heading claims restoration was certain.

Bonaparte domestic political role explicitly retrieves321 artillery advice,330 evidence/addresses/Augereau and332 uneasy Directors. His Egyptian expedition route also supplies the facet’s333 departure context; the politics of removal are separate from military success.

The French army hierarchy distinguishes Vendémiaire from the political mainstay of the Directory. Its successive passages cover Police Legion dissolution, generals and troops in Fructidor, and340 future abandonment; it does not frame the forecast as a coup already completed.

Named Floréal and Year VI routes retrieve electoral engineering, exclusions and changed personnel. The Jacobin disputed constitutional threat subdivision specifically preserves the counterfactual uncertainty rather than calling the excluded opposition a proved conspiracy.

Pichegru royalist approaches and treason/Fructidor subdivisions retrieve his contacts, presidency, evidence and arrest. The personal treason wording is not extended to the heterogeneous elected majority.

The named republic hierarchy and sister-republic subservience route retain Swiss imposition, Roman commandant supremacy, Championnet acting against the Directory, local Ligurian drafting, imposed Cisalpine government, and the distinct Batavian sequence of support, coups, elections and relative internal autonomy. These are separate concrete routes, not an undifferentiated puppet-state umbrella.

Directorial Terror is explicitly labelled so-called; émigré334, noble citizenship334 and clerical334–335 routes let the reader distinguish death law, weak anti-noble enforcement and clerical deportation. The wording does not equate this with Year II scale.

Directorial commissioners328/334 gives the administrative and fiscal machinery. Year V and émigré329 retrieve the electoral restrictions, while Year VI336 supplies officials and split assemblies. Thus all four functions can be reached through specific administration/election routes despite only328/334 beneath the named commissioner heading.

The Jacobin hierarchy separates post-Vendémiaire revival, 1797–98 electoral challenge, resurgence1799 and suppression1799. Constitutional circles gives the distinct intermediate formation. The372 suppression evidence includes rejected impeachment motions; headings do not convert accusations against Schérer or Directors into convictions or a Jacobin majority.

Directory inauguration names the initial Directors and basis of selection321. The later turnover is reached in its relevant Year V election329, Fructidor331 and Floréal337 accounts. Different episodes have clear chronological access; no claim of stable collective capacity is introduced.

The325 passage reaches women’s memories without endorsing them as the narrator’s verdict; no unresolved first-lookup uncertainty is retained from the predecessor.

The named Vendémiaire range reaches organization, prolonged fighting, uncertain royalist composition, mild repression and dismantled local institutions. Military victory is not equated with a uniformly royalist rising.
